content: I umeqqran n imeɣnajen. Azehhed n Dawud.
A SIDI, ajeǧid ifarḥ s jjehd nnec, mammec ifarḥ aṭṭas s usenjem nnec!
Tewcid as meẓri n wuř nnes, Cek war tugid ca azaweg n iyencicen nnes. Silah.
Maɣar Cek tusid-dd i umsagar akides s lbarakat ccurent s řxar, teqqned as ttaj n wureɣ ittwaṣeffan x uzeǧif nnes.
Ittar ac tudart, tewcid as tt, tuzzeggart n wussan i řebda qaɛ.
Imɣar uɛuǧi nnes s usenjem nnec, tesszehhjed t s tissiqt d řɛezz.
Minzi Cek tarrid i-t d lbaraka tameqqrant i řebda, Cek teccured t s řefraḥet ɣar wudem nnec.
Maɣar ajeǧid ittcař x SIDI, war ittefriɣ s tmexsiwt icewwaren n Umɛuǧi x kuřci.
Afus nnec ad yaf marra řɛedyan nnec, afus afusi nnec ad yaf marra inni Cek icarrhen.
Cek ad ten tarrid am tefqunt icemmḍen di řweqt n weḍḥar nnec, SIDI ad ten isarḍ s weɣḍab nnes, timessi ad ten tecc.
Ad temḥid řɣiǧet nsen zi temmurt, zzariɛet nsen zi tarwa n bnadem.
Maɣar nitni nedyen ac řɣar, ggin ict n tmeɛmuč, maca war zemmaren walu.
Maɣar Cek ad ten tegged jar tiṭṭawin, s ifiřan n řqews nnec ad tneyyced x wudmawen nsen.
Sgeɛɛed ixef nnec, a SIDI, s jjhed nnec! Ejj aneɣ ad nɣennej u ad nzehhed i tzemmar nnec.
